description: 阅读理解：基于项目内容的选择题，检验理解程度

questions.question: What is this project about?
questions.questionCn: 这个项目是关于什么的？

options.label: B
options.text: About making our home better and greener.
options.textCn: 关于让我们的家园更好、更环保。

questions.explanation: 项目名称是 A better home（更好的家园），主题是让家园更环保、更美好。

questions.question: How many rubbish bins do they have before the plan?
questions.questionCn: 计划之前他们有几个垃圾桶？
questions.explanation: And we have only one rubbish bin. 而且我们只有一个垃圾桶。

questions.question: What is not very green in the kitchen?
questions.explanation: My mum uses plastic bags when she goes shopping. That's not very green. 我妈妈购物时使用塑料袋，那不是很环保。

questions.question: What wastes a lot of water in the bathroom?
questions.questionCn: 卫生间里什么浪费很多水？

options.label: A
options.text: Turning off the tap when brushing teeth.

options.label: B
options.text: Leaving the tap running when brushing teeth.
options.textCn: 刷牙时让水龙头一直流着。

questions.explanation: Sometimes my dad leaves the tap running when he brushes his teeth. That wastes a lot of water. 有时候我爸爸刷牙时让水龙头一直流着，那浪费很多水。

questions.question: How many parts are there in the green home plan?
questions.questionCn: 绿色家园计划有几部分？
questions.explanation: we have a three-part plan. 我们有一个三部分的计划。分别是：First节约能源水，Second减少浪费回收，Third旧物再利用。

questions.question: What is the first thing in the plan?
questions.questionCn: 计划的第一件事是什么？
questions.explanation: First, we will save energy and water. 第一，我们要节约能源和水。

questions.question: What will they use instead of plastic bags?
questions.questionCn: 他们要用什么代替塑料袋？
questions.explanation: We will use cloth bags instead of plastic bags. 我们要用布袋代替塑料袋。

questions.question: What can they make with old cans?
questions.questionCn: 他们可以用旧易拉罐做什么？
questions.explanation: We can make pencil holders with old cans. 我们可以用旧易拉罐做笔筒。

questions.question: What does "Small changes make a big difference." mean?
questions.questionCn: 「Small changes make a big difference.」是什么意思？

options.label: B
options.text: Even small changes can have a big effect.
options.textCn: 即使是小改变也能有大影响。

questions.explanation: make a difference 是固定短语，意思是「有影响；有作用」。这句话的意思是：小小的改变也能带来大大的不同/大影响。

questions.question: How was their home before?
questions.explanation: Our home was not very green before. 我们的家以前不是很环保。

questions.question: What did they make with old T-shirts?
questions.explanation: And this shopping bag! We made it with an old T-shirt. 还有这个购物袋！我们用一件旧T恤做的。

questions.question: What did they make with old buttons?
questions.questionCn: 他们用旧纽扣做了什么？
questions.explanation: We also made this pretty picture with old buttons. 我们还用旧纽扣做了这幅漂亮的画。

questions.question: What are the three stages of this project?
questions.questionCn: 这个项目的三个阶段是什么？

options.label: B
options.text: Home survey, Green home plan, Home showcase.
options.textCn: 家居环境调查、绿色家园计划、成果展示。

questions.explanation: 项目分为三个阶段：Home survey（家居环境调查）→ Green home plan（绿色家园计划）→ Home showcase（成果展示）。

questions.question: Which units does Project 2 integrate?
questions.questionCn: Project 2 整合了哪几个单元的知识？
questions.explanation: Project 2 A better home 整合了后四单元（Unit 5-Unit 8）的内容：Keeping our city clean、Going green、Old things new life、Then and now。

questions.question: What is the main idea of this project?
questions.questionCn: 这个项目的主旨是什么？

options.label: A
options.text: We should buy more new things for our home.
options.textCn: 我们应该为家里买更多新东西。

options.label: B
options.text: We can make our home better and greener through small changes and reusing old things.
options.textCn: 我们可以通过小改变和旧物再利用让家园更好、更环保。

options.label: C
options.text: It's impossible to change our home.
options.textCn: 改变我们的家是不可能的。

options.label: D
options.text: We should waste more water and electricity.
options.textCn: 我们应该浪费更多水和电。

questions.explanation: 项目主题是 A better home（更好的家园），通过家居调查、绿色计划和成果展示，告诉我们小小的改变加上旧物再利用，可以让我们的家园变得更环保、更美好。
